events.title: Frankfurt Street Food Night Market
events.description: Monthly street food market at the old wholesale market hall (Kleinmarkthalle area). Over 40 food vendors, live cooking shows, craft beer, and live music. A paradise for food lovers.

events.title: Senckenberg Museum: Dinosaur Exhibition
events.description: The Senckenberg Natural History Museum, one of Europe's largest natural history museums, features stunning dinosaur skeletons including the famous 'Tristan' T-Rex. Special summer exhibition on prehistoric marine life.

events.title: Schirn Kunsthalle: New Exhibition Opening
events.description: The Schirn Kunsthalle presents its latest contemporary art exhibition. One of Europe's most prestigious exhibition venues, known for groundbreaking shows spanning classical modernism to contemporary art.

events.title: Palmengarten: Summer Night Concert Series
events.description: Open-air classical and pop concerts in the stunning Palmengarten botanical gardens. Bring a picnic and enjoy world-class music surrounded by exotic plants and flowers under the summer sky.

events.title: Römerberg Summer Cinema
events.description: Open-air cinema on Frankfurt's historic Römerberg square. Watch classic and contemporary films under the stars with the medieval Römer buildings as your backdrop. Bring a blanket!

events.title: Frankfurt Riverboat Party Cruise
events.description: A summer night party cruise on the Main River. DJ sets, cocktails, and panoramic views of Frankfurt's illuminated skyline from the water. A unique way to experience the city.
events.location: Departs from Eiserner Steg, Mainkai, Frankfurt

events.title: Nippon Conn
events.description: Germany's largest Japanese pop culture convention in Frankfurt. Anime screenings, cosplay competitions, manga artists, J-pop concerts, Japanese food market, and workshops on everything from calligraphy to voice acting.

events.title: Mainfest Frankfurt
events.description: Traditional summer festival along the Main River featuring live music, carnival rides, regional food specialties (Handkäse, Grüne Soße, Apfelwein), and a spectacular fireworks display over the river on Saturday evening.
events.location: Mainkai, along Main River between Friedensbrücke and Untermainbrücke

events.title: Frankfurt Jazz Festival
events.description: International jazz musicians perform across multiple venues in Frankfurt. From intimate club sessions to open-air concerts along the Main. Features both established legends and emerging artists.
events.location: Various venues across Frankfurt (Jazzkeller, HR-Sendesaal, Mainufer)

events.title: Apfelwein Festival
events.description: Celebrate Frankfurt's signature apple wine (Apfelwein) at this lively festival in Alt-Sachsenhausen. Sample dozens of local Apfelwein varieties, traditional Frankfurter cuisine, and live folk music.

events.title: Eintracht Frankfurt: Bundesliga Home Match
events.description: Experience the electric atmosphere of a Bundesliga match at Deutsche Bank Park. Watch Eintracht Frankfurt take on a top-flight opponent in one of Germany's most passionate football stadiums.
events.location: Deutsche Bank Park, Mörfelder Landstraße 362, 60528 Frankfurt

events.title: Museumsuferfest
events.description: Frankfurt's biggest cultural festival along the Museumsufer riverbank. Over 30 museums open their doors with special exhibitions, live music, dance performances, and international food stalls along the Main River.
events.location: Museumsufer, along both sides of Main River, Frankfurt

events.title: Frankfurt Goethe Museum: Special Exhibition
events.description: The Goethe House museum presents a new special exhibition exploring the life and works of Johann Wolfgang von Goethe, Frankfurt's most famous son. Rare manuscripts, personal artifacts, and interactive installations.

events.title: Oper Frankfurt: Der Fliegende Holländer
events.description: Wagner's dramatic opera 'The Flying Dutchman' performed by the renowned Frankfurt Opera ensemble. A haunting tale of a cursed sea captain and redemption through love.

events.title: Museumsufer: Nacht der Museen
events.description: The Night of Museums — over 40 museums across Frankfurt open their doors until 2 AM with a single ticket. Special guided tours, live performances, and late-night bar installations at each venue. Shuttle buses connect all locations.

events.title: Frankfurter Buchmesse 2026
events.description: One of the world's largest book fairs. Meet authors, publishers, and literary agents from around the globe. Special exhibits, readings, and panel discussions throughout the fairgrounds.

events.title: Frankfurt Christmas Market
events.description: One of Germany's oldest and most beautiful Christmas markets on the Römerberg. Over 200 stalls selling handcrafted gifts, Christmas decorations, mulled wine (Glühwein), roasted almonds, and traditional Frankfurter Bethmännchen.
